item.rift_quests.quest_book.lore: Use it to open your quests.
item.rift_quests.seal_castle_city.lore_1: Struck when the last wall of the city was raised.
item.rift_quests.seal_castle_city.lore_2: Nothing behind it was ever left unguarded.
item.rift_quests.seal_desert_citadel.lor: Pressed into the gate of a walled city of sand.
The sun keeps its hours there, and so does the watch.
item.rift_quests.seal_ice_settlement.lor: Cast from the first frost at the edge of the world.
The cold keeps whatever it is given.
item.rift_quests.seal_jungle_city.lore_1: Cut from vine and old stone beneath the canopy.
item.rift_quests.seal_jungle_city.lore_2: The city grows, and the jungle allows it.
item.rift_quests.seal_jungle_temple.lore: Pulled from a temple half swallowed by roots.
Something inside still counts its visitors.
item.rift_quests.seal_monastery.lore_1: Set with the last turn of a prayer wheel.
item.rift_quests.seal_monastery.lore_2: The mountain listens, and answers late.
item.rift_quests.seal_pyramid_row.lore_1: Stamped on three pyramids, each larger than the last.
item.rift_quests.seal_pyramid_row.lore_2: The smallest was only the beginning.
item.rift_quests.seal_river_oasis.lore_1: Carried upriver by the first boat to reach the palms.
item.rift_quests.seal_river_palace.lore_: Pressed in amber beside a palace on the water.
Its lamps burn for guests who have not yet arrived.
